# Workhorse Group Postpones Third Quarter Earnings Release and Conference Call


November 12, 2026 • 4:00 PM EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_4b1eacf3340f4a997383e33af5a6b092/workhorse/news/2026-11-12_Workhorse_Group_Postpones_Third_Quarter_Earnings_343.pdf)


### Conference call rescheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. Eastern time


DETROIT, Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Workhorse Group Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=gVR8xACeh-fDMy3HJ4KNDB-WCgmCIML4P8yAbnl5BbdQXWakuIO3OmYFUe9yojmOVHsdefJHQLnqYZEsud4yubMhyXCkRmVsDGMLvUXcB7mOQdJ2Qoie-IESdLYz1UMXBoZIAxVUceFuKXXORY8rZY6abCbPPmTJlwW9ofwhlOXYNfGl0cP17B5rc96RpIQhicgSibhfRisp_1K64KKFEVyXGPBVoBsTtOd83LT7eB75u0A-hOsVC-d4TqK2Y_Ex2fO5fyzZ0ZrHjM-h_M5rWA==) (NASDAQ: WKHS) (“Workhorse”), an American Industrial Technology company, has rescheduled the conference call for its third quarter results and business outlook originally scheduled for **Thursday, November 12, 2026** , at **4:30 p.m. Eastern time** until **Monday November 16, 2026 at 4:30 p.m.** Eastern time.


The rescheduling is due to business disruptions caused by the global Microsoft outages taking place today, November 12.


Prior to the conference call, Workhorse will issue its third quarter earnings press release. **ABOUT WORKHORSE GROUP**


Headquartered in the Detroit area, Workhorse Group Inc. (Nasdaq: WKHS) is an American industrial technology company that designs, engineers, and produces the intelligent industrial machines that are the lifeblood of modern economies. From its manufacturing facility in Union City, Indiana, Workhorse applies its electrification, high-voltage systems integration, ruggedized platform manufacturing and distributed energy capabilities to its electric commercial vehicles and modular AI infrastructure products.
